# Awesome Copilot Prompts – Index

This index lists all reusable Copilot and agent prompts in the [`awesome-copilot`](./awesome-copilot/) subfolder.

Each prompt is designed to accelerate workflow, code review, documentation, and automation for LightSpeed WordPress and web projects.

> **Usage:**
>
> - Browse the table below to discover available prompts.
> - Open any file to copy its contents for Copilot Chat or GitHub Actions.
> - All prompts follow LightSpeed’s [coding standards](../instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md) and [AI agent conventions](../../AGENTS.md).

---

## Guidance

- All prompts include LightSpeed YAML frontmatter for discoverability and automation.
- Update this index when new prompts are added or existing prompts are changed.
- See [custom-instructions.md](../custom-instructions.md) for full org guidance, and [coding standards](../instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md) for prompt authoring rules.
